systems.system: Digital Civil Registration System (DCRS) pilot: digitisation of existing paper records
systems.owner: Ministry of Territorial Administration, with support from Enabel and the European Union
systems.tiers: ten pilot municipalities, including some in Conakry and Kindia, from October 2022

systems.system: Digital Civil Registration System (DCRS) pilot: mobile application for birth notification
systems.owner: Ministry of Territorial Administration, with support from Enabel and the European Union
systems.tiers: health centres, notifying the civil registry; ten pilot municipalities

note: The brief describes the civil registration pilot by two functions only: digitising existing paper birth, marriage and death records, and creating automatic notification of future births from health centres by mobile application; neither is the office making the digital record at registration, so no civil fact. It also says rural municipal offices rely on manual reporting and paper-based records, in general terms and not of civil registration specifically, and that 44,493 vital events were registered on time in 2022.
